table_description: Very small lookup table (~35 rows) containing return reason codes and descriptions. Referenced by all three return fact tables: STORE_RETURNS.SR_REASON_SK, CATALOG_RETURNS.CR_REASON_SK, and WEB_RETURNS.WR_REASON_SK. Essential for return reason analysis.
use_cases: Return reason breakdown across all channels
Most common return reasons by item category
Return reason impact on net loss
data_quality_notes: R_REASON_DESC is a human-readable description like 'Did not fit', 'Not as described', 'Defective', etc.
This table is very small (35 rows) — safe to use in any join without performance concern.

table_columns.name: R_REASON_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by all three return fact tables.

table_columns.name: R_REASON_DESC
table_columns.description: Human-readable return reason description (e.g. 'Did not fit', 'Defective', 'Not as described').
